scope.source_layout: The card's packages/adapters/zcode/project-memory.ts target maps to the existing packages/adapters/zcode/src/project-memory.ts layout.

additional_seams.reason: The accepted U02 seam requires one bounded synchronous provider capture per admitted turn, ticket-owned snapshot lifetime, and receipt-correlated Read. When enabled, Host requires projectMemory plus projectMemoryReadPort, wraps the Native FileSystemPort before Native app creation, and verifies the snapshot project_id matches the port project.
The actual Hook rebuilds the per-turn packet from trusted ticket data while preserving nonce, session, transcript, and receipt checks.

Pinned Native Read can return file_unchanged from its session cache after stat if mtime and size match, bypassing range and Host source revalidation. This narrow port supplies a per-Read span revision and routes selected-memory stat/range through the current receipt-bound Host reader; unit-02 verifies automatic createNativeApp FileSystemPort wiring with a synthetic Native factory and delegate.

The accepted U02 parser probe found Marked and YAML unavailable in Xiadie; exact direct dependencies and retained licenses avoid handwritten Markdown/YAML parsers and absolute imports from reference checkouts.

scope.boundary: The actual Host automatically passes the decorated Native FileSystemPort at createNativeApp when enabled with matching projectMemory and projectMemoryReadPort. Unit-02 exercises this through a synthetic Native factory and FileSystem delegate, checks snapshot/project identity and live receipt correlation, and runs the installed Hook source in a fixed-Node child process. The Native core itself was not loaded; independent Native Read integration remains NOT_RUN for U09.

limitations: The selected-topic/index and parser byte/depth bounds are finite; oversized packet composition fails closed under the Host's 12000-byte UTF-8 upper bound rather than truncating.
Stable-handle and final hash checks detect observed changes but do not claim a filesystem-wide atomic snapshot against all concurrent writers.
General filesystem write sandboxing is not implemented or claimed by U04; U07 owns the broader handoff/reviewer write boundary.
Native Read end-to-end and real model behavior remain NOT_RUN.
